chains.title: Unauthenticated → cloud account compromise

steps.enables: use leaked role for cloud access

preconditions: app IAM role has metadata-reachable permissions
chains.impact: An external attacker with no credentials reaches the cloud control plane via the fetch feature.

chains.title: SQLi → admin takeover → console execution
preconditions: admin hashes are crackable or session forgeable
chains.impact: Database read via SQLi feeds the auth bypass, culminating in full admin console control.
